channel.title: WillowinWorld Devlog
channel.description: Latest production notes for WillowinWorld mobile games.

item.title: Nature Seed: Ten-level vertical prototype
item.description: The playable vertical prototype now joins ten levels, constrained physical line drawing, efficiency stars and persistent progress.

item.title: Candy Shop: Containers, planning tools and special effects
item.description: The active build combines a 13-stage candy chain with ten container rulesets, eight effect families, next-three planning, hold and daily challenges.

item.title: Paint Blasters: 35 projectile recipes implemented
item.description: Five pure, twenty mixed and ten rainbow projectile strategies now resolve in the production prototype.

item.title: Ball is God?!: Active systems and world pass
item.description: Active production spans ten locations, deterministic tower generation, combo smash, shield, Karma rules and validation coverage.
